Dear
We author this letter to advise you of the status of Mr. Epstein's ongoing
settlement discussions with the attorney-representative Robert Josefsberg.
First, during the week of April 26, 2010 Mr. Epstein settled each and every
case and potential case with all of Mr. Josefsberg's clients including the
litigation styled Jane Doe 103 v Epstein. The claims or potential claims of
each person on your victim list who chose to rely on the attorney
representative have been fully resolved to the satisfaction of Mr. Josefsberg.
The last remaining issue relating to the attorney-representative is the issue
of legal fees. A final accounting has not yet been presented to Mr. Epstein
by Mr. Josefsberg or his firm. We have sought such an accounting as a
predicate to determining the extent to which the charges are within Mr.
Epstein's NPA-related obligations which he reaffirms unconditionally and to
avoid reaching interim settlements that are then followed by additional
invoices which potentially include disputed charges. As we have previously
stated, amongst the invoices are charges that Mr. Epstein's civil counsel
believe are outside his NPA-obligations.
Mr. Epstein has executed a Special Master Agreement offering to have all
outstanding fee-related issues resolved by a neutral third party and also
remains available to continue settlement conversations aimed at the same
objective, a final resolution of the fee issues. As of the present, the attorneyrepresentatives lawyers are indicating they prefer to initiate litigation rather
than submit the dispute to a neutral third party or to continue discussions
with Mr. Epstein's counsel to reach an amicable and non-adversarial
resolution of the issues thus their continues to remain a significant
outstanding balance which is in dispute and thus unpaid. Again, Mr. Epstein
awaits a final accounting of outstanding invoices through the date of the
settlement of the last five cases or potential cases, so that further efforts to
reach an overall settlement of all NPA-obligations can be achieved with
finality

EFTA00587279
